propose.title: Headstash claim page: set Azure Calcium theme on terpy + thioly
propose.description: Sets the Headstash claim page theme (R12) on the DAO-owned cw-headstash instances terpy terp16ww6y3e7y63v98d9jzg0cft2u0ztx5kda0zvr0e90kwawh4hxweqhtvv7q and thioly terp1yc4qtcwzv6g55vqrj95xq8anruwyy2ly4narcqs4a2hzgnu6rlrsa4s9r7 via the owner-only set_theme. Theme: Azure Calcium (Terp Network (user-supplied tokens, 2026-11-04)), light and dark token sets (bg, surface, surfaceAlt, text, textMuted, border, borderStrong, accent, onAccent, focus), canonical JSON sha256 e3f1c91756f0a72017658229985766f00ef323345ed29d3411915ade85b9908c. The contract validates every token (#RRGGBB, no unknown fields); the page validates again and falls back to the frontend manifest default, then the built-in theme. No funds move. Reverting is set_theme {theme: null}.
